_description: Per-silo primary metrics aligned with Phase 1 taxonomy (PD-01..PD-10). Each silo corresponds to exactly one PD code from the codebook produced in Phase 1 Framework Synthesis.

portfolio-optimization.scope_notes: Asset allocation, rebalancing, index tracking, factor investing, ESG-constrained, multi-objective, QUBO formulations

derivative-pricing.scope_notes: European/American/Asian/barrier/exotic options, CVA/XVA, Black-Scholes extensions, stochastic volatility

risk-management.scope_notes: VaR, CVaR, stress testing, credit risk, systemic risk, counterparty risk, tail risk, risk aggregation

quantum-ml-finance.p1_name: Machine Learning and Pattern Recognition in Finance
quantum-ml-finance.scope_notes: QML classification, regression, forecasting, sentiment analysis, financial NLP, clustering, pattern recognition. Includes time-series forecasting and return prediction.

fraud-detection.scope_notes: Fraudulent transactions, AML, transaction monitoring, anomaly detection in financial networks, KYC

trading-execution.scope_notes: Algorithmic trading, optimal execution, arbitrage, HFT, market microstructure, order routing

credit-lending.scope_notes: Credit scoring models, default prediction, loan approval, creditworthiness assessment

cryptography-security.scope_notes: QKD, post-quantum cryptography, threats to RSA/ECC, cybersecurity in financial infrastructure, quantum-safe alternatives

simulation-monte-carlo.scope_notes: Monte Carlo integration, stochastic simulation, path simulation, random walks, quantum simulation of financial processes

insurance-actuarial.scope_notes: Insurance pricing, actuarial models, underwriting optimisation, claims prediction
